review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: The news media brings too many impacts on how people live now and this is an adverse development. Personally, I believe that media really affects society, but it is not fully bad.

Admittedly, news media has too many effects on people's lives. This is primarily because the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet, those technologies allow people to follow the news instantly. This means that wherever and whenever they are, news has become a regular part of their routine. Beside that, the intense competition among news outlets, in order to gain attention, leads to that most media agencies often focus on shocking and breaking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner. In this way, with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, it reinforces the overall impact of news on public opinion.

Despite that, news media brings lots of positive effects. It exposures to a certain stream of distressing and exaggerated new, leading to overwhelm people and make them feel overly anxious and helpless, even in situation that do not directly affect them. However, news coverage also warn the public to existing and looming problems in society, such as crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. This naturally follows that individuals can be better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats, actually resulting in it can handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, although it is true that news media may bring about a few disadvantages to people, however, I am convinced that it is not really bad.

completion.comment: Em đã hoàn thành đủ bốn phần trên trang nguồn đã xác minh.

review.overall: Em đã viết đủ bốn phần và đủ chuỗi ý từ tiếp cận tin tức, cạnh tranh hãng tin đến tác hại tinh thần và lợi ích cảnh báo. Tuy nhiên, bài còn nhiều lỗi dựng câu nền: access bị bỏ dở, leads to that, It exposures ... leading to và resulting in it can handle. Em cần viết lại, giữ các ý đang có và tự kiểm tra chủ ngữ–động từ của từng câu. Cô không bắt lỗi cách dùng media số ít xuyên suốt bài và giữ cách em vận dụng mẫu This naturally follows Cô giao.

paragraphs: It is argued that news media has a substantial impact on how people live now and that this is an adverse development. Personally, I believe that media really affects society; however, this influence is not entirely negative.

Admittedly, news media has a substantial influence on people's lives. This is primarily because the widespread access to smartphones and the Internet allows people to follow the news instantly. In conclusion, although it is true that news media may bring about a few disadvantages to people, I am convinced that its substantial influence is not entirely negative.

task.text:
The news media have too much influence on people’s lives today and this is a negative development.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
